messages:
Elaine: Quick proposal: run a 6-month pilot for a graduated credit that decays every 2 months for SI + HW bundle to accelerate POC->commit conversions. Key goals: higher reserved-conversion, predictable renewal runway. Sketch below — please react with concerns.

```text
Months 0-2: 40% HW credit applied to private-offer SKU (cap $200k)
Months 3-4: 20% credit
Months 5-6: 10% credit + 30-day commit window to convert to reserved capacity
Renewal kicker (12mo): 5% additional credit if commit increases >20%
```

Mike: Love the structure. One concern: marketplace private-offer UI and partner approval constraints. Need to check cloud partner approval lead times (~2w). cc @Tara

Tara: FYI marketplace private offers can support custom SKUs and tiered credits, but partner legal/listing needs pre-clear. Approval + testing of redemption flow is typically 10–14 business days. Also we should surface redemption verification to SI ops.

Anil: From field: SIs keep asking for a clear renewal promise. Suggest we make the renewal kicker explicit in offer terms and include a simple SLA: if they hit X usage vs commit we auto-apply credit. Also track metric: 'POC->reserved conversion rate' weekly.

Elaine: Good calls. I'll add the renewal SLA language and loop in eng-platform to ensure redemption API surface supports automated crediting and telemetry (usage tags). Who can do a quick 15m tomorrow to align on listing requirements and telemetry events?

announce-bot: :rotating_light: Heads-up — any partner-facing announcement/offer text must go through legal & partner-ops review before publishing. Please submit draft here: https://redwood.internal/workflows/partner-offer-review

Mike: I can do 10:30am PT. Sending calendar invite now. :+1:
